confirmed_defects.description: compareOutputs() drops top-level fields (warmup_attempted, warmup_succeeded, warmup_error, effective_settings, trials, trial_measurements, aggregate_latency).
confirmed_defects.impact: Cold-Start Warning badge in OutputComparisonView.tsx never displays on warm-up failure.
confirmed_defects.remediation: Update compareOutputs() to map all 14 backend fields.
confirmed_defects.resolution: Added mapping for all 14 fields in api.ts compareOutputs(), added null guards, added frontend/tests/api.test.ts regression tests.

confirmed_defects.description: test_end_to_end_optimize_endpoint_with_requested_budget fails with HTTP 400 when executed in isolation because LocalModelRegistry.refresh() makes an unmocked /api/tags call.
confirmed_defects.impact: Test suite fails if this specific test is run standalone without the full test suite cache.
confirmed_defects.remediation: Patch LocalModelRegistry.refresh() or routing/registry httpx client in the test.
confirmed_defects.resolution: Mocked LocalModelRegistry client and /api/tags in test_output_budget.py for clean isolated execution.

confirmed_defects.description: Directional entity relation regex only captures single-word tokens (r'\bfrom\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.\/]+)\s+to\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.\/]+)\b'), failing on multi-word phrases.
confirmed_defects.impact: Reversal of multi-word sources/destinations (e.g. 'savings account' to 'checking account') is not caught by Check 14a.
confirmed_defects.remediation: Support non-greedy multi-word phrases bounded by punctuation or conjunctions.
confirmed_defects.resolution: Implemented dual-stage directional relation extraction in TaskAnalyzer for both single-token and multi-word phrases (1-4 words) with boundaries, conjunction stops, and range exclusions. Enhanced CandidateValidator Check 14a to check both forward and inverted reversal patterns.

potential_risks_and_limitations.description: Generic Proper Noun Extraction: TaskAnalyzer only extracts KNOWN_TECH_ENTITIES, multi-capital CamelCase, or uppercase acronyms. Generic geographical or institutional proper nouns without multiple capitals are not extracted into entities.
potential_risks_and_limitations.mitigation: Expand entity extraction with title-case sequences or preserve named entities with general capitalization heuristics.
potential_risks_and_limitations.resolution: Implemented multi-word title-case sequence extraction and mid-sentence proper noun detection with GENERIC_FUNCTIONAL_WORDS filtering in TaskAnalyzer.

potential_risks_and_limitations.description: Tokenizer Fallback Divergence: cl100k_base digit and multilingual tokenization diverges from native Qwen 2.5 BPE when Ollama is offline.
potential_risks_and_limitations.mitigation: Preserve live Ollama daemon for production-grade token metrics and keep provenance label prominently displayed.

potential_risks_and_limitations.description: Equating Structural Prompt Validity with Downstream Quality: Benchmark reports must not claim downstream response quality is guaranteed merely by prompt-level constraint preservation.
potential_risks_and_limitations.mitigation: Clarify that 'Dispatched Semantic Preservation' measures deterministic prompt constraint retention on dispatched prompts.
